move: three phones rise staggered, straighten in 3D, screens scroll, drop out
how: An aurora background zooms 1.05 to 1.12 with a slight vertical drift over the whole 4s. Three phone mockups rise from y 640 with expo.out over 0.9s, staggered 0, 0.1 and 0.18s, the outer two pre-rotated rotateY +/-18 and pushed inward; a caption fades in at 15%. From 22% the side phones ease to rotateY +/-8 and x 0 with power2.inOut over 1.2s while the row floats up 30px, and each screen's content scrolls up 90-120px with power3.inOut, staggered 0.15s, the dashboard bars growing from scaleY 0 with back.out(1.6). At 82% the phones drop out right-to-left with expo.in and the caption fades.
adapt: Replace the three screen mock-ups (any HTML inside .content), the caption and the background image; adjust the scroll distances to the content height; keep the 0.9s expo.out rise, the 0.1s stagger and the 1.2s straighten.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the background and three phones from shot.screens; animate returns the timeline with rise at 0, straighten at 0.22D, scroll at 0.25D and drop at 0.82D. Needs perspective on el and preserve-3d on the row; the 640/700px offsets assume a 720px-tall stage so derive from el height; from() tweens need immediateRender:false when composed.
caveats: background uses filter: saturate/brightness on a full-frame image
